metadata.purpose: Non-electrical annotation cards; keep one live circuit instance.
metadata.limits: All equations nominal; examples are not measured guarantees.

USB.title: USB-C input and ESD
lines: J1: 5 V input + USB data, either plug orientation.
R1/R2 = 5.1k: sink detection, not USB-PD negotiation.
D1: ESD transient diversion; keep its return short.
C1 1uF + C2 100nF: local VBUS bypass.
VBUS -> D2 -> SYS_IN; VBUS -> R30 -> charger.
R38/R39 (I/O sheet): 22R data-edge damping.

charger.title: Single-cell 4.2 V charging
lines: U3: constant-current then constant-voltage charging.
I_CHG(mA) ~= 1000/R3(kohm) = 100mA for 10k.
C3 1uF: input bypass; C4 4.7uF: battery-node support.
R30 CHG_LINK: DNP first; fit after cell/harness checks.
100mA = 0.2C/500mAh or 0.1C/1000mAh; verify rating.
P ~= (VUSB - VBAT) x I_CHG; charge taper adds time.

protection.title: Cell connector and protection
lines: J2: pin1 B_PLUS, pin2 B_MINUS; meter cable polarity.
U4 monitors faults; Q3 interrupts the cell return.
R4/C5 supply filter: 100R x 100nF = 10us.
Ideal fc = 1/(2*pi*R4*C5) = 15.9kHz.
R5 1k is sense-input series resistance, not that RC.
Never bridge B_MINUS to GND; thresholds are IC-set.

sharing.title: Source sharing and ON/OFF control
lines: USB: VBUS -> D2 -> SYS_IN; battery: B_PLUS -> Q1.
R6 100k pulls Q1 gate low when USB is absent.
USB raises Q1 gate; its orientation blocks backfeed.
SW1 ON grounds LED_GATE; R7 100k enables U5.
SW1 OFF grounds SYS_EN; R41 turns Q5 off.
Control current only: 4.2V/100k = 42uA per pull-up.

LDO.title: 3.3 V LDO and transient charge
lines: U5 AP2112: owned linear regulator; no converter.
C7/C10 10uF: local input/output charge and bypass.
P_LDO ~= (VSYS - 3.3V) x Iavg; check USB heating.
dV ~= dI*dt/Ceff: 0.1A*10us/10uF = 0.10V.
Short transient support only; bias/ESR reduce margin.

ADC.title: Battery divider and safe off-state
lines: VADC = VBAT*10k/(30k+10k) = VBAT/4.
4.2V -> 1.05V; divider current = 105uA.
Q4 follows +3V3; blocks battery feed when rail is off.
tau = 7.5us; fc = 1/(2*pi*Rth*C) = 21.2kHz.
OFF: R16*C29 = 10us; fast discharge, not 5s smoothing.

MCU.title: Processor, memory and GPIO roles
lines: U1 FH4R2: 4MB flash + 2MB quad PSRAM in package.
Initial firmware: 4MB flash; PSRAM disabled.
GPIO0 BOOT/cancel; 1 buzzer; 2 battery ADC.
LoRa: 8 DIO0, 9 RST, 10 CS, 11 MOSI, 12 CLK, 13 MISO.
GPIO19/20 USB D-/D+; GPIO48 RGB data.
Phone provides GPS/IMU over BLE; exposed pad is GND.

decoupling.title: MCU rail bypass and RF supply filter
lines: L1 2nH + C11/C12/C13: RF supply filtering/bypass.
C14 10uF: bulk; C15/C16 100nF: CPU/RTC bypass.
C21 10nF + C22 1uF: analog supply bypass.
C17/C20 1uF/100nF: separate VDD_SPI bypass.
Ideal |Xc|=1/(2*pi*f*C); real ESR/ESL also matter.
Place close to pins; VDD_SPI is not tied to +3V3.

reset.title: Enable timing and boot straps
lines: R8/C33 on MCU_EN: 10k x 1uF = 10ms nominal tau.
Ideal VEN(t)=VDD*(1-exp(-t/tau)); 63% at one tau.
Actual release depends on threshold and rail ramp.
R34 10k pulls GPIO0 up; R35/R36 pull GPIO45/46 down.
Straps are sampled near reset; do not fight these nets.
SW2 resets EN; SW3 grounds BOOT (I/O sheet).

crystal.title: 40 MHz clock and load estimate
lines: Y1 target CL = 10pF; C24/C25 start at 12pF each.
CL ~= C24*C25/(C24+C25) + Cstray.
12pF pair -> 6pF; assumed 4pF stray -> 10pF.
R9 22R is a drive/damping starting choice.
Differs from Espressif's 24nH series starting guidance.
Measure startup, frequency and harmonics before acceptance.

RF.title: 2.4 GHz matching and antenna
lines: C18/L2/C19: chip-side CLC starting match.
C32/L4/L5: antenna-side starting match; not yet tuned.
These reactances do not prove a 50R system match.
ANT1 serves S3 2.4GHz; preserve its no-metal corner.
Tune with PCB/enclosure/body; LoRa uses its own antenna.

LoRa.title: 433 MHz radio and SPI interface
lines: FB1 feeds LORA_VDD; C26 10uF + C27 100nF bypass it.
Ferrite impedance varies with frequency/current; no RC fc.
R11 33R damps SCK; R37 10k holds NSS high at startup.
Radio: 433MHz, SF9, BW125kHz, CR4/5, 17dBm, sync0x34.
GPIO9 resets U2; GPIO8 receives DIO0 interrupt.
Hand-solder bottom U2; attach 433MHz antenna before TX.

RGB.title: Raw-supply RGB and data translation
lines: Q5 switches SYS_IN -> LED_PWR; R41 100k holds it off.
U6 translates GPIO48 to LED voltage; no power conversion.
C34/C35 bypass U6 rails; C28 bypasses LED1 (100nF each).
R13 33R damps edges; R42/R43 100k define low states.
Bits H/L: 0=300/1000ns, 1=700/600ns; reset>=300us LOW.
LED1 DNP first; actual minimum voltage/current unqualified.

buzzer.title: Active buzzer low-side driver
lines: Current: +3V3 -> active BZ1 -> Q2 -> GND.
GPIO1 supplies base drive through R12=330R.
Example IB=(3.3-0.8)/330=7.58mA; VBE is assumed.
Conservative example: (2.4-1.2)/330=3.64mA.
R14 100k holds OFF; D3 returns magnetic kick current.
Verify actual buzzer current/tone; hand-solder after reflow.

controls.title: Manual controls and USB damping
lines: SW2 grounds MCU_EN; SW3 grounds BOOT/cancel.
Download: hold BOOT, tap RESET, then release BOOT.
R38/R39=22R series: D+/D- edge damping near U1.
These are not a DC divider or a power-current limiter.
Keep matched routing and a nearby ground return.

testpoints.title: Bring-up access and measurement reference
lines: TP1 GND; TP2 +3V3; TP3 B_PLUS; TP8 SYS_IN.
TP4 UART_TX; TP5 UART_RX; TP6 EN; TP7 BOOT.
UART is 3.3V logic; do not drive an unpowered MCU.
Scope reference is protected GND, not a B_MINUS bridge.
These are copper pads, not eight purchased components.
Power flags are ERC declarations, not physical supplies.
